meta.escopo: Company tag, the v1 subset: registration, certificate and NFS-e configuration. The per-service configuration of the other eight fiscal documents is out of v1.
meta.objetivo: Single source of the Portuguese-to-English mapping for the Company operations. Same conventions as de-para/nfse-dps.json.
meta.estadoDeConfianca: CONFIRMED against the OpenAPI spec (swagger 2.0, ACBr API 3.1.17) on 2026-11-09: definitions Empresa, EmpresaEndereco, EmpresaConfigNfse, EmpresaConfigNfseRegTrib, EmpresaConfigRps and EmpresaConfigPrefeitura. The three tax regime fields were marked nomeJsonPendente and the spec confirmed every guess: they are nested under regTrib and named opSimpNac, regApTribSN and regEspTrib. Their values were documented in prose rather than as an enum, which is why the generator reported them as empty options. What is still unconfirmed is the shape of the responses, not the requests.
meta.avisoSeguranca: The certificate operation receives the A1 file in Base64 plus its password. n8n persists execution data in its database, so those values can remain in the history. The password is typed as 'password', the node never echoes this payload in an error, and the README recommends the console as the default path.

inscricao_municipal.name: municipalTaxRegistration
inscricao_municipal.description: Municipal tax registration number (inscricao_municipal). Required by many cities for NFS-e.

endereco.numero.name: streetNumber
endereco.numero.description: Street number (endereco.numero). A string, so it accepts values like "379-A" and "S/N".

endereco.complemento.name: addressComplement
endereco.complemento.description: Extra address information (endereco.complemento). Up to 500 characters.

endereco.codigo_municipio.name: cityCode
endereco.codigo_municipio.description: IBGE code of the city (endereco.codigo_municipio). The Postal Code lookup returns it.

certificado.name: certificate
certificado.description: A1 digital certificate encoded in Base64 (certificado). Prefer uploading it through the ACBr API console — this operation exists for automated onboarding at scale.
certificado.nota: Never echo this value in an error message. Consider accepting binary data from the workflow and converting it, instead of a string.

password.name: certificatePassword
password.nota: Typed as password so n8n masks it in the UI. That does not prevent it from being persisted in execution data.

configuracaoNfse.nota: Confirmed against EmpresaConfigNfse in the spec. The values here are INJECTED by the API into the DPS — confirmed by opSimpNac and regEspTrib appearing in the transmitted XML and absent from the JSON that was sent. Note that the spec still carries wording from the provider the API migrated from, naming it in the rps descriptions; do not copy that into user-facing text.

rps.lote.name: nextBatchNumber
rps.lote.description: Next RPS batch number to be used (rps.lote).

rps.numero.name: nextInvoiceNumber
rps.numero.description: Next RPS number to be used (rps.numero).

regTrib.opSimpNac.name: simplesNacionalStatus
regTrib.opSimpNac.description: Status of the company under the Simples Nacional regime (regTrib.opSimpNac). The API injects it into the DPS as prest.regTrib.opSimpNac.

options.label: Opting in — Micro or Small Business (ME/EPP)

regTrib.regApTribSN.name: simplesNacionalAssessmentRegime
regTrib.regApTribSN.description: Which regime the federal and municipal taxes fall under, for a company opting in as ME/EPP (regTrib.regApTribSN). Only meaningful when Simples Nacional Status is "Opting in — Micro or Small Business", and only when a Simples Nacional limit was exceeded.

options.label: Federal and municipal taxes assessed under the Simples Nacional
Federal taxes under the Simples Nacional, ISSQN outside it
Federal and municipal taxes both outside the Simples Nacional

regTrib.regEspTrib.name: specialTaxRegime
regTrib.regEspTrib.description: Special tax regime in the national standard (regTrib.regEspTrib). Sent to the national environment as given; when the API sends straight to a city hall it converts the value to that city's own code where a conversion exists.
regTrib.regEspTrib.nota: Some city halls have codes with no national equivalent. For those, the issuing endpoint accepts prest.regTrib.regEspTrib per invoice — see de-para/nfse-dps.json.

incentivoFiscal.name: hasTaxIncentive
incentivoFiscal.description: Whether the company holds a municipal tax incentive.

prefeitura.login.name: cityHallLogin
prefeitura.login.description: Login required by some city halls for direct communication.
prefeitura.login.nota: If the municipality requires it and it is not configured, issuing fails.

prefeitura.senha.name: cityHallPassword
prefeitura.senha.description: Password required by some city halls for direct communication.

prefeitura.token.name: cityHallToken
prefeitura.token.description: Token required by some city halls for direct communication.

numeracao_automatica.name: automaticNumbering
numeracao_automatica.description: Whether the API controls the invoice numbering for this company (numeracao_automatica).

pendentes.nota: Company operations in v1 whose payloads have not been mapped yet.
